summary: Port deterministic body constraint-list sorting as a real irregular integer kernel, preserving its Rust module and live entry-point oracle.
regressions: Duplicate IDs with original-position tie break
High unsigned IDs and highly skewed 513-entry row
differences: Uses the same one-group-per-body, 64-lane ranking algorithm as Rust; comparison is bitwise, with no float conversion.
This establishes indexed gather, bounded variable loops and unique scatter for one real operation. It does not validate atomics, collective scans, BVH traversal or the complete collision pipeline.
Handoff packaging and returned-buffer comparison now select buffer names and comparison rules from each operation contract.
